data.Name: TP-02 | Gather Victim Identity Information: Credentials
data.Source: X3M.AI Threat Profile - System Integrator - TP-02 Partner Center / Delegated Administration Compromise
data.Description: Collect credentials associated with partner administrators, Admin agents, technical users and personnel likely to operate Partner Center or delegated administration workflows. Why it matters for a system integrator/MSP: Partner identities can be substantially more valuable than ordinary end-user identities because compromise may expose Partner Center, delegated customer relationships and administrative paths into downstream Microsoft tenants. Primary assets / relationships at risk: Partner administrators, Admin agents, Privileged Entra identities, Customer-facing technical identities. Attack-path stage: Target Partner Administrators. Detection opportunities: Credential exposure monitoring; Identity Protection leaked-credential detections; Correlate exposed identities with Partner Center roles. Defensive considerations: Use dedicated privileged identities; Phishing-resistant MFA; No privileged use from general-purpose accounts.

data.Source: X3M.AI Threat Profile - System Integrator - TP-02 Partner Center / Delegated Administration Compromise
data.Description: Delete, disable, alter or remove permissions from legitimate partner administrative accounts in order to impede response and preserve attacker control. Why it matters for a system integrator/MSP: After gaining high privilege, an adversary may remove legitimate administrators or revoke their access, delaying containment while the attacker continues to exploit partner or delegated administration paths. Primary assets / relationships at risk: Partner administrators, Incident responders, Privileged accounts. Attack-path stage: Lock Out Partner Administrators. Detection opportunities: Privileged account disable/delete events; Bulk permission removals; Unexpected admin lockout. Defensive considerations: Protected emergency-access accounts; Out-of-band recovery process; Alert on privileged account removal.
